intro.title: Celebrity Rhine River Cruises
paragraphs: The Rhine River is one of Europe's most recognizable waterways, connecting historic cities, vineyard-covered hills, medieval towns, castles and major cultural destinations.

Celebrity River Cruises brings its new premium river cruise experience to the Rhine for 2027 and 2028, with itineraries connecting destinations such as Amsterdam, Cologne, Rüdesheim, Strasbourg, Basel and other Rhine-region ports. Celebrity's current Rhine program includes 7-night itineraries, while selected sailings can be combined with Before and After Stays to create a longer European vacation.

For travelers considering their first European river cruise—or comparing Celebrity with other premium river cruise lines—the Rhine offers a particularly strong combination of scenery, history, food, wine and accessible European cities.

quickAnswer.title: What Are Celebrity Rhine River Cruises?
quickAnswer.text: Celebrity Rhine River Cruises are premium European river cruises sailing the Rhine and connected waterways, with 2027 and 2028 itineraries visiting destinations across the Netherlands, Germany, France and Switzerland. Celebrity's current Rhine program includes 7-night sailings, one shore excursion per day, meals, Wi-Fi and included beverages, with Before and After Stay options available on selected journeys.

glance.title: Celebrity Rhine River Cruises at a Glance
glance.note: Celebrity states that its 2027 Rhine itineraries are 7 nights and can visit multiple countries, while its Rhine program highlights Amsterdam, Cologne, Strasbourg and Basel among its featured destinations.

whereToSail.title: Where Does Celebrity Rhine River Cruises Sail?
whereToSail.subtitle: Celebrity's Rhine itineraries are designed around the river's changing landscapes and the cities and towns along its route.
whereToSail.footerNote: The exact ports depend on the sailing and itinerary direction. For example, Celebrity's 2028 Amsterdam to Basel itinerary includes Amsterdam, Rotterdam, Cologne, Rüdesheim, Speyer, Strasbourg, Breisach and Basel.

items.title: Amsterdam
items.description: Iconic Dutch starting gateway with historic canals, world-class museums, and vibrant local neighborhoods.

items.title: Rotterdam
items.description: Leading global maritime hub celebrated for bold modern architecture and innovative design.

items.title: Cologne
items.description: Historic German metropolis dominated by the twin-spired High Gothic Cathedral along the riverfront.

items.title: Rüdesheim
items.description: Heart of the scenic Rhine Gorge known for steep terraced vineyards and traditional wine taverns.

items.title: Speyer
items.description: One of Germany's oldest cities featuring the magnificent Romanesque Speyer Imperial Cathedral.

items.title: Strasbourg
items.description: Alsatian capital blending French gastronomy and German timbered architecture along scenic canals.

items.title: Breisach
items.description: Picturesque gateway nestled between the Rhine River and Germany's enchanting Black Forest.

items.title: Basel
items.description: Swiss cultural capital offering seamless cruise connections to the Swiss Alps and Lake Geneva.

items.title: Scenic Rhine Sailing
items.description: Cruising through the UNESCO Upper Middle Rhine Valley past dozens of hilltop medieval castles.

items.title: Additional Rhine & Main Destinations
items.description: Extended waterways connecting picturesque tributary towns and regional cultural centers.

route.title: Celebrity Rhine River Cruise Map & Route
route.subtitle: A typical Rhine itinerary can move from the Netherlands toward Switzerland, passing through some of the most recognizable landscapes of western Europe.

combines.title: Dutch Canals & Architecture
combines.description: Gable-fronted canal houses, historic waterways, and vibrant flower markets.

combines.title: German River Towns
combines.description: Half-timbered medieval villages and historic riverside promenades.

combines.title: Rhine Valley Vineyards
combines.description: Steep terraced Riesling vineyards rising above the riverbanks.

combines.title: Medieval Landscapes & Rhine Castles
combines.description: Dozens of legendary fortress ruins and UNESCO-protected river vistas.

combines.title: French Culture & Alsatian Charm
combines.description: World-renowned French cuisine, Petite France canals, and European institutions.

combines.title: Swiss Gateways & Alpine Connections
combines.description: Direct disembarkation access into Switzerland and onward Alpine connections.

route.note: Celebrity's 2028 itinerary documents this Amsterdam-to-Basel route as an 8-day journey, with the sailing moving through the Scenic Rhine and destinations including Cologne, Rüdesheim and Strasbourg.

cityProfiles.title: Featured Ports & Rhine River Destinations
cityProfiles.subtitle: Explore the distinct heritage, architectural wonders, and culinary traditions of the Rhine's premier riverside destinations.

cities.title: Amsterdam
cities.description: Amsterdam is one of the most popular gateway cities for Rhine River cruises. Before boarding, travelers can explore historic canals, museums, art, Dutch architecture, local neighborhoods, and restaurants and cafés. It is also an excellent city for extending a Rhine vacation with a pre-cruise stay.

cities.title: Rotterdam
cities.description: Rotterdam provides a sharp contrast to Amsterdam. Known for its modern architecture and major port, Rotterdam adds a contemporary European perspective to the Rhine journey. Celebrity's 2028 Amsterdam-to-Basel itinerary includes Rotterdam on Day 2.

cities.title: Cologne
cities.description: Cologne is one of Germany's most recognizable Rhine cities. Highlights include Cologne Cathedral, historic old town, Rhine waterfront, local food, German beer culture, and museums and cultural attractions. The city is included on selected Celebrity Rhine itineraries.

cities.title: Rüdesheim
cities.description: Rüdesheim is particularly appealing to travelers interested in wine and traditional Rhine scenery. The town sits within the Rhine Valley landscape, surrounding vineyards, and historic villages. Celebrity's Rhine itineraries feature Rüdesheim as an important destination, including its Amsterdam-to-Basel 2028 itinerary.

cities.title: Strasbourg
cities.description: Strasbourg sits near the French-German cultural border and offers a distinctive combination of French cuisine, German architectural influences, historic neighborhoods, canals, half-timbered buildings, and European institutions. Celebrity describes Strasbourg as a destination where French and German influences come together.

cities.title: Basel
cities.description: Basel is an important gateway between the Rhine region and Switzerland. Travelers can use Basel as a cruise embarkation point, disembarkation point, Swiss extension destination, or starting point for additional European travel. Celebrity's current Rhine program highlights Basel as one of its principal Rhine cities.

citiesGlance.title: Rhine River Cruise Cities at a Glance
citiesGlance.note: Not every Celebrity Rhine sailing visits every city, so travelers should compare the individual itinerary before booking.

inclusions.title: What Is Included on Celebrity Rhine River Cruises?
inclusions.subtitle: Celebrity's Rhine River Cruises include several core elements in the cruise fare:
points: Shore Excursions — One included every day in every port of call
Dining — Included gourmet meals, with multiple choices & a 24-hour option
Drinks — Selected wine, beer, cocktails, coffee & soft drinks throughout the day
Wi-Fi — Complimentary high-speed internet throughout the journey
Onboard Experiences — Access to relaxation, dining, and entertainment spaces
inclusions.note: Celebrity's river ships provide multiple spaces for relaxation, dining and entertainment as part of the onboard experience.

excursions.title: Celebrity Rhine River Cruise Excursions
excursions.subtitle: One of the major advantages of river cruising is the ability to reach city centers and cultural destinations without repeatedly packing and unpacking. Celebrity includes one shore excursion per day.
focusPoints: Historic cities and medieval town centers
Gothic, Romanesque, and modern European architecture
Local Rhine and Alsatian wine cellar excursions
World-class European art galleries and museums
Historic castles, fortifications, and landmark tours
Authentic local European traditions and folklore
excursions.note: Travelers can also choose additional experiences where available. Celebrity's Rhine program emphasizes locally connected experiences designed to bring travelers closer to the destinations.

seasons.title: Best Time for a Celebrity Rhine River Cruise
seasons.subtitle: There is no single best month for everyone. The ideal season depends on what you want to experience.

cards.title: Spring Rhine River Cruises
cards.description: Spring can be particularly attractive for travelers interested in the Netherlands and seasonal flowers. Celebrity specifically highlights tulip season as one of the reasons to consider a spring Rhine sailing.

cards.title: Summer Rhine River Cruises
cards.description: Summer provides longer daylight hours and comfortable opportunities for exploring riverside towns, walking tours, and open-air scenic sailing.

cards.title: Fall Rhine River Cruises
cards.description: Autumn transforms the Rhine Valley with seasonal colors. Celebrity highlights the vineyards turning golden during the fall, ideal for wine-focused travel.

cards.title: Christmas Market Rhine Cruises
cards.description: Late November and December bring a completely different atmosphere. Celebrity highlights the region's world-famous Christmas markets as a major seasonal attraction.

seasonTable.title: Best Time to Take a Celebrity Rhine River Cruise
seasonTable.note: The right season depends more on the experience you want than on a universally 'best' month.

ships.title: Celebrity Compass
ships.description: Celebrity Compass is designed specifically around the river experience, with open-air lounges, spacious interiors, and the innovative Skylight Infinite Balcony Suite concept.

In-room purified and filtered drinking water

accommodations.title: Celebrity Rhine River Cruise Accommodations
accommodations.subtitle: Celebrity's river accommodations are designed around river views and natural light. 100% outside-facing staterooms with zero interior cabins.

cabins.title: River View Stateroom
cabins.description: Designed for travelers who want a comfortable river-facing room with natural light without moving into a suite category.
features: Approximately 157 sq. ft. of efficient living space
King-size bed with optional twin configuration
Premium luxury bedding and European linens
Spacious bathroom with oversized walk-in shower
Generous natural daylight and river-facing views
cabins.bestFor: Value-focused travelers seeking comfortable river views and premium amenities.

cabins.title: Infinite Balcony Stateroom
cabins.description: Features Celebrity's innovative lowering panoramic window that transforms your living room into an open-air river balcony at the touch of a button.
features: Seamless indoor-outdoor river views and fresh European air
Maximizes indoor living space in all weather conditions
King-size bed and modern luxury furnishings
cabins.bestFor: Travelers wanting flexible outdoor access and seamless indoor/outdoor living in all weather.

cabins.title: Skylight Infinite Balcony Suite
cabins.description: The most distinctive accommodation in Celebrity's river cruise fleet, featuring a dramatic overhead ceiling window and full suite amenities.
features: Approximately 233 sq. ft. with separate living and sleeping areas
Overhead ceiling skylight window filling the suite with natural light
Spa-style luxury bathroom with premium amenities
cabins.bestFor: Luxury travelers seeking iconic design, dramatic overhead ceiling glass, and comprehensive suite perks.

cabins.title: Vista Balcony Suite
cabins.description: Provides expanded space, premium comfort, and an expansive private step-out veranda overlooking the river scenery.
features: Panoramic river views with expansive private step-out veranda
cabins.bestFor: Travelers wanting expanded space, premium comfort, and an expansive private step-out veranda.

beforeAfter.title: Rhine River Cruise Before & After Stays
beforeAfter.subtitle: A Celebrity Rhine River Cruise does not have to begin or end when the ship does. Celebrity offers Before and After Stays that allow travelers to add time in European cities before or after their river sailing. Current options include Amsterdam, Budapest, Prague, and Lausanne.
includes: Premium or Ultra Premium hotel accommodations
Seamless airport, hotel, and port logistics

amsterdamBefore.title: Amsterdam Before Your Rhine Cruise
amsterdamBefore.description: Amsterdam is one of the most natural places to extend a Rhine River cruise. A pre-cruise stay provides extra time for canal exploration, museums, art galleries, local dining, historic neighborhoods, and Dutch culture. Rather than arriving the day the ship departs, adding extra nights can make the European vacation feel more relaxed.

baselAfter.title: Basel After Your Rhine Cruise
baselAfter.description: Basel serves as the premier starting point for additional Switzerland travel. A post-cruise extension can connect the Rhine experience with the Swiss Alps, lake regions, French-speaking Switzerland, and additional European destinations. Celebrity's Before and After Stay program includes Lausanne among its available city experiences.

beforeAfterTable.title: What's Included in Celebrity Before & After Stays?
rows: Premium or Ultra Premium hotel options
Flexible options based on stay duration
beforeAfterTable.note: Celebrity says these experiences are designed to handle the key logistics between hotel and ship while providing locally focused experiences.

riverVsOcean.subtitle: A Rhine River cruise is fundamentally different from Celebrity's ocean cruise experience.

One shore excursion per day included
Shore excursions booked separately or as add-ons
Open ocean sea days & vast maritime horizons

Multiple European ports in close proximity
Broader global itinerary choices with longer sea transits
riverVsOcean.note: Celebrity describes its river program as more intimate, with experiences both onboard and onshore designed around Europe's cultural and historic cities.

whoShouldChoose.title: Who Should Choose a Celebrity Rhine River Cruise?
rows: The Rhine offers an easy introduction to European river cruising because it combines recognizable cities with scenic sailing.
Travelers already familiar with Celebrity may enjoy experiencing the brand in a more intimate river environment.
The relaxed pace, European cities and scenic sailing make the Rhine particularly well suited to couples.
The Rhine region offers vineyards, regional cuisine and food-focused experiences.
The itinerary connects major European cultural centers with historic riverside towns.
The variety of excursions and relatively relaxed travel format can work well for families traveling across generations.

faqs.question: 1. What is a Celebrity Rhine River Cruise?
faqs.answer: A Celebrity Rhine River Cruise is a premium European river cruise experience sailing the Rhine and connected waterways, with itineraries visiting destinations across countries including the Netherlands, Germany, France and Switzerland.

faqs.question: 2. When do Celebrity Rhine River Cruises begin?
faqs.answer: Celebrity's inaugural river cruises begin in August 2027, with Rhine and Danube itineraries offered for 2027 and 2028.

faqs.question: 3. How long are Celebrity Rhine River Cruises?
faqs.answer: Celebrity's current 2027 Rhine itineraries are 7 nights. Individual 2028 itineraries may be presented with different day-count formats depending on the sailing and any included overnight stays.

faqs.question: 4. Which cities does Celebrity visit on the Rhine?
faqs.answer: Celebrity Rhine itineraries can include Amsterdam, Rotterdam, Cologne, Rüdesheim, Speyer, Strasbourg, Breisach and Basel, although the exact ports depend on the itinerary.

faqs.question: 5. Does Celebrity Rhine River Cruises sail from Amsterdam?
faqs.answer: Yes. Celebrity offers Rhine itineraries beginning in Amsterdam, including an Amsterdam-to-Basel itinerary in its 2028 program.

faqs.question: 6. Does Celebrity Rhine River Cruises sail to Basel?
faqs.answer: Yes. Basel is one of the featured Rhine destinations, and Celebrity offers itineraries between Amsterdam and Basel.

faqs.question: 7. What is included on Celebrity Rhine River Cruises?
faqs.answer: Celebrity includes one shore excursion per day, meals, Wi-Fi and selected beverages, including wine, beer, cocktails, coffee and soft drinks, with upgrade opportunities available.

faqs.question: 8. Are shore excursions included on Celebrity Rhine cruises?
faqs.answer: Yes. Celebrity includes one shore excursion every day on its river cruises.

faqs.question: 9. Is Wi-Fi included on Celebrity Rhine River Cruises?
faqs.answer: Yes. Complimentary Wi-Fi is included throughout the journey.

faqs.question: 10. Are drinks included on Celebrity Rhine River Cruises?
faqs.answer: Yes. Celebrity includes selected wine, beer, cocktails, coffee and soft drinks throughout the day, with opportunities to upgrade.

faqs.question: 11. What is the best time for a Celebrity Rhine River Cruise?
faqs.answer: The best time depends on your interests. Spring is attractive for tulips, summer for longer days, fall for vineyard scenery and late November through December for Christmas markets.

faqs.question: 12. Are Celebrity Rhine River Cruises good for Christmas markets?
faqs.answer: Yes. Celebrity specifically highlights late November through December as a prime season for Rhine Christmas market experiences.

faqs.question: 13. Are Celebrity Rhine River Cruises good in the fall?
faqs.answer: Yes. Fall can be especially appealing for travelers interested in vineyards and autumn scenery, as Celebrity highlights the Rhine Valley's vineyards turning golden during the season.

faqs.question: 14. What ships sail Celebrity Rhine River Cruises?
faqs.answer: Celebrity's river fleet includes ships such as Celebrity Compass and Celebrity Seeker, with additional ships planned as the river program expands.

faqs.question: 15. Does Celebrity Compass sail the Rhine?
faqs.answer: Celebrity Compass is part of the new Celebrity River Cruises fleet and is designed for European river itineraries, including the Rhine program. Its features include open-air spaces and Skylight Infinite Balcony Suites.

faqs.question: 16. Does Celebrity River Cruises offer Before and After Stays?
faqs.answer: Yes. Celebrity offers pre- and post-cruise experiences in cities including Amsterdam, Budapest, Prague and Lausanne, with hotel accommodations, breakfast, transfers and curated local experiences.

faqs.question: 17. Can I add an Amsterdam hotel stay before my Rhine cruise?
faqs.answer: Yes. Amsterdam is one of Celebrity's featured Before and After Stay destinations, allowing travelers to extend their European vacation before sailing.

faqs.question: 18. What is included in Celebrity Before and After Stays?
faqs.answer: Packages can include Premium or Ultra Premium hotel accommodations, daily breakfast, transportation, guided experiences and local destination support.

faqs.question: 19. Is a Celebrity Rhine River Cruise better than a Danube cruise?
faqs.answer: It depends on the destinations you prefer. The Rhine is especially strong for castles, vineyards, Amsterdam, Cologne and Strasbourg, while the Danube offers destinations such as Vienna and Budapest.

faqs.question: 20. Are Celebrity Rhine River Cruises worth it?
faqs.answer: They can be an excellent choice for travelers seeking a new premium river cruise experience with modern ships, included daily excursions, European city access and optional pre- and post-cruise extensions.

faqs.question: 21. What is the best Celebrity Rhine River Cruise itinerary?
faqs.answer: There is no single best itinerary. An Amsterdam-to-Basel sailing can be particularly attractive for first-time travelers because it combines the Netherlands, Germany, France and Switzerland in one journey.

faqs.question: 22. Who should take a Celebrity Rhine River Cruise?
faqs.answer: Celebrity Rhine River Cruises are particularly well suited to couples, first-time river cruisers, Celebrity ocean cruise guests, food and wine travelers, and travelers interested in European history and culture.
